body: ## What - omarchy-agent-usage-update discovers collectors in $OMARCHY_PATH/bin, then overlays ~/.config/omarchy/agents/collectors (XDG_CONFIG_HOME). - Same id: user collector replaces packaged. - README documents the user dir. - test/shell.d/agent-usage-update-test.sh: custom collector runs; packaged good is overridden; 11 ok. ## Why Fixes omacom/omarchy#9602. The agents plugin README said shipping a collector adds a tab, but discovery only scanned the package-owned bin dir.

title: omarchy #9544 launch-or-focus agent titles (fork PR)
body: ## What - omarchy-launch-or-focus skips windows with class org.omarchy.agent so agent titles cannot swallow app bindings. - omarchy-launch-spotify matches window class only (not title). - test/shell.d/launch-or-focus-test.sh stubs hyprctl: agent title no longer focuses; Spotify class still does; non-agent titles still match; 7 ok. ## Why Fixes omacom/omarchy#9544. SUPER+SHIFT+M focused an Omarchy agent (or browser tab) whose title contained “Spotify” instead of launching Spotify.
